note: 英语母语者→中文高频迁移规则（0.22 方向1）。锚定 recognizer 实际降类（type 四枚举 + knowledge_point_id），fragment/correction 签名二次确认。假设只作 candidate，绝不进确诊图谱。

rules.title: 量词缺失或泛化
rules.l1_anchor: English numbers nouns directly ('three apples', 'a phone') with no classifier system
rules.zh_signature: 数词直接连名词（三苹果→三个苹果），或一律泛化用'个'（一个手机→一部手机）

rules.title: 领属/修饰'的'遗漏
rules.l1_anchor: English marks possession and modification without a particle ('my friend', 'Tom's book', 'beautiful clothes')
rules.zh_signature: 代词/名词/形容词直接连名词缺'的'（我朋友书→我朋友的书；漂亮衣服→漂亮的衣服）

rules.title: 数量词后置
rules.l1_anchor: English splits 'many' (before noun) from 'a lot' (after verb); learners keep the quantity word after the verb phrase
rules.zh_signature: '很多/不少'等留在动词后（买苹果很多→买很多苹果）

rules.title: 形容词谓语句：系动词冗余或裸形容词
rules.l1_anchor: English requires 'be' before adjectives (She is happy); Chinese adjectives predicate directly, and a bare adjective needs a degree word (很)
rules.zh_signature: '是+形容词'（我是高兴→我很高兴），或裸形容词缺程度词（她高兴→她很高兴）

rules.title: 动态助词'了/着/过'缺失或误加
rules.l1_anchor: English marks time on the verb itself (-ed / -ing / have done); Chinese marks aspect with particles after the verb
rules.zh_signature: 完成义缺'了'（昨天我去学校→去了），或体标记误加/误删

rules.title: 疑问词前置
rules.l1_anchor: English fronts question words (What do you want?); Chinese keeps them where the answer belongs (你要什么?)
rules.zh_signature: 疑问词留在句首（什么你要→你要什么）
